使用伦敦行政区边界与 fly-tipping 属性表，按地区代码连接并绘制专题地图。连接后保留 33 个 borough。

```{r setup, include=FALSE, eval=TRUE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(eval = TRUE, echo = TRUE, dev = "ragg_png", dpi = 120)
```

## 1.4 数据与 Excel 透视表

原始数据来自 London Data Store，存于 `data/raw/london/`。Shapefile 的 shp、shx、dbf、prj 配套保留。Excel 透视表以地区代码为行、年份为列、`total_action_taken` 为值并求和，去掉额外标题和总计，另存 `week01/data/processed/fly-tipping-pivot.csv`。

## 1.5 包与项目

安装块仅在缺包时运行。

```{r install, eval=FALSE}
install.packages(c("here", "sf", "tidyverse", "tmap", "RSQLite", "readxl"))
```

## 加载工具

`sf` 处理矢量，`tidyverse` 整理表格，`tmap` 制图，`RSQLite` 读写数据库。

```{r load-tools}
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
library(tmap)
root <- here::here()
```

## 读取边界

`shape` 包含行政区属性和 geometry；`st_crs()` 查看坐标参考系，`st_geometry()` 只取形状。

```{r read-boundary}
boundary <- file.path(root, "data/raw/london/boundaries/statistical-gis-boundaries-london/ESRI/London_Borough_Excluding_MHW.shp")
shape <- sf::st_read(boundary, quiet = TRUE)
stopifnot("GSS_CODE" %in% names(shape), !anyNA(shape$GSS_CODE), !anyDuplicated(shape$GSS_CODE))
summary(shape)
sf::st_crs(shape)
plot(sf::st_geometry(shape))
```

## 读取属性表

优先读取本周透视表；否则使用保留的 GB18030 中文宽表，规范代码、年份和总计字段。

```{r read-pivot}
pivot_file <- file.path(root, "week01/data/processed/fly-tipping-pivot.csv")
if (file.exists(pivot_file)) {
  mycsv <- readr::read_csv(pivot_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
} else {

  mycsv <- readr::read_csv(
    file.path(root, "data/raw/london/attributes/fly-tipping-borough.csv"),
    locale = readr::locale(encoding = "GB18030"), show_col_types = FALSE)
}
names(mycsv)
if ("Row Labels" %in% names(mycsv)) mycsv <- dplyr::rename(mycsv, GSS_CODE = `Row Labels`)
if ("行标签" %in% names(mycsv)) mycsv <- dplyr::rename(mycsv, GSS_CODE = `行标签`)
if ("2011/12/1" %in% names(mycsv)) mycsv <- dplyr::rename(mycsv, `2011_12` = `2011/12/1`)
stopifnot("GSS_CODE" %in% names(mycsv))
mycsv <- mycsv %>%
  dplyr::filter(GSS_CODE != "总计") %>%
  dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of("总计")) %>%
  dplyr::rename_with(~ gsub("-", "_", .x))
stopifnot("GSS_CODE" %in% names(mycsv), !anyNA(mycsv$GSS_CODE), !anyDuplicated(mycsv$GSS_CODE))
```

## 按代码连接

两侧 `anti_join()` 检查未匹配，唯一键验证后执行一对一左连接。

```{r join-and-check}
stopifnot("GSS_CODE" %in% names(shape), !anyNA(shape$GSS_CODE), !anyDuplicated(shape$GSS_CODE))
stopifnot("GSS_CODE" %in% names(mycsv), !anyNA(mycsv$GSS_CODE), !anyDuplicated(mycsv$GSS_CODE))
dplyr::anti_join(sf::st_drop_geometry(shape), mycsv, by = "GSS_CODE")
dplyr::anti_join(mycsv, sf::st_drop_geometry(shape), by = "GSS_CODE")
shape2 <- dplyr::left_join(shape, mycsv, by = "GSS_CODE", relationship = "one-to-one")
stopifnot(nrow(shape2) == nrow(shape))
head(sf::st_drop_geometry(shape2), 10)
```

## 专题地图

`2011_12` 表示 2011–12 年采取行动次数，不是事件总数；缺失值保留为 NA。

```{r first-map}
year_column <- "2011_12"
stopifnot(year_column %in% names(shape2))
tmap::tmap_mode("plot")
tmap::tm_shape(shape2) + tmap::tm_polygons(fill = year_column)
```

## 导出 GeoPackage

导出连接后的 `shape2`，另加 `original_csv` 表；时间戳文件名保留旧结果。

```{r export-new-geopackage, eval=FALSE}
dir.create(file.path(root, "week01/outputs"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
target <- file.path(root, "week01/outputs", paste0("flytipping-tutorial-",
  format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d-%H%M%S"), ".gpkg"))
stopifnot(!file.exists(target))
sf::st_write(shape2, target, layer = "london_boroughs_fly_tipping", quiet = TRUE)
con <- DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), dbname = target)
tryCatch({
  print(DBI::dbListTables(con))
  DBI::dbWriteTable(con, "original_csv", as.data.frame(mycsv), overwrite = FALSE)
}, finally = DBI::dbDisconnect(con))
sf::st_layers(target)
```

## Homework：新西兰

使用 Territorial Authority 2018 generalised 边界和 Census 的 `2018 paid employee`。完整处理见 [homework.Rmd](homework.Rmd)。SA1 与 territorial authority 是不同空间层级。

```{r homework-start, eval=FALSE}
library(readxl)
census <- file.path(root, "data/raw/nz2018/census/2018-SA1-dataset-individual-part-3a-total-NZ_updated_16-7-20.xlsx")
readxl::excel_sheets(census)
preview <- readxl::read_excel(census, sheet = "Territorial authority", col_names = FALSE, n_max = 12)
preview
```

阅读：Goodchild，Geocomputation with R 第 2 章。
